text: My family is my strength and my weakness.
author: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan

text: To us, family means putting your arms around each other and being there.
author: Barbara Bush

text: The family is one of nature's masterpieces.
author: George Santayana

text: A family is a risky venture, because the greater the love, the greater the loss... That's the trade-off. But I'll take it all.
author: Brad Pitt

text: Having family responsibilities and concerns just has to make you a more understanding person.
author: Sandra Day O'Connor

text: The children have been a wonderful gift to me, and I'm thankful to have once again seen our world through their eyes. They restore my faith in the family's future.
author: Jackie Kennedy

text: The greatest thing in family life is to take a hint when a hint is intended-and not to take a hint when a hint isn't intended.
author: Robert Frost

text: The only rock I know that stays steady, the only institution I know that works, is the family.
author: Lee Iacocca

text: The family is the first essential cell of human society.
author: Pope John XXIII

text: Dignity is not negotiable. Dignity is the honor of the family.
author: Vartan Gregorian

text: I find the family the most mysterious and fascinating institution in the world.
author: Amos Oz

text: The family is the test of freedom; because the family is the only thing that the free man makes for himself and by himself.
author: Gilbert K. Chesterton

text: Give a little love to a child, and you get a great deal back.
author: John Ruskin

text: I love cooking for myself and cooking for my family.
author: Al Roker

text: I woke up one morning thinking about wolves and realized that wolf packs function as families. Everyone has a role, and if you act within the parameters of your role, the whole pack succeeds, and when that falls apart, so does the pack.
author: Jodi Picoult

text: I am the family face; flesh perishes, I live on.
author: Thomas Hardy

text: I think togetherness is a very important ingredient to family life.
author: Barbara Bush

text: It takes a lot of work to put together a marriage, to put together a family and a home.
author: Elizabeth Edwards

text: The family is the nucleus of civilization.
author: Will Durant

text: Family is not an important thing. It's everything.
author: Michael J. Fox

text: If a country is to be corruption free and become a nation of beautiful minds, I strongly feel there are three key societal members who can make a difference. They are the father, the mother and the teacher.
author: A. P. J. Abdul Kalam

text: Family is the most important thing in the world.
author: Princess Diana

text: Sister is probably the most competitive relationship within the family, but once the sisters are grown, it becomes the strongest relationship.
author: Margaret Mead

text: You are the bows from which your children as living arrows are sent forth.
author: Khalil Gibran

text: I believe the world is one big family, and we need to help each other.
author: Jet Li

text: A family is a place where principles are hammered and honed on the anvil of everyday living.
author: Charles R. Swindoll

text: A man should never neglect his family for business.
author: Walt Disney

text: My father used to play with my brother and me in the yard. Mother would come out and say, 'You're tearing up the grass'; 'We're not raising grass,' Dad would reply. 'We're raising boys.'
author: Harmon Killebrew

text: My kids give me the balance to live right.
author: Celine Dion

text: I don't think anyone has a normal family.
author: Edward Furlong

text: Tennis is just a game, family is forever.
author: Serena Williams

text: It didn't matter how big our house was; it mattered that there was love in it.
author: Peter Buffett

text: Call it a clan, call it a network, call it a tribe, call it a family: Whatever you call it, whoever you are, you need one.
author: Jane Howard

text: We may have our differences, but nothing's more important than family.
author: Coco

text: The bond that links your true family is not one of blood, but of respect and joy in each other's life.
author: Richard Bach

text: Being a family means you are a part of something very wonderful. It means you will love and be loved for the rest of your life.
author: Lisa Weed

text: The strength of a family, like the strength of an army, lies in its loyalty to each other.
author: Mario Puzo

text: The most important thing in the world is family and love.
author: John Wooden

text: When everything goes to hell, the people who stand by you without flinching–they are your family.
author: Jim Butcher

text: In family life, love is the oil that eases friction, the cement that binds closer together, and the music that brings harmony.
author: Friedrich Nietzsche

text: Family faces are magic mirrors. Looking at people who belong to us, we see the past, present, and future.
author: Gail Lumet Buckley

text: Families are the compass that guides us. They are the inspiration to reach great heights, and our comfort when we occasionally falter.
author: Brad Henry

text: So much of what is best in us is bound up in our love of family, that it remains the measure of our stability because it measures our sense of loyalty.
author: Haniel Long

text: Everyone needs a house to live in, but a supportive family is what builds a home.
author: Anthony Liccione

text: You don't choose your family. They are God's gift to you, as you are to them.
author: Desmond Tutu

text: Parents are like God because you wanna know they're out there, and you want them to think well of you, but you really only call when you need something.
author: Chuck Palahniuk

text: The informality of family life is a blessed condition that allows us all to become our best while looking our worst.
author: Marge Kennedy

text: The greatest gift of family life is to be intimately acquainted with people you might never even introduce yourself to, had life not done it for you.
author: Kendall Hailey

text: Having a place to go is a home. Having someone to love is a family. Having both is a blessing.
author: Donna Hedges

text: That's what people do who love you. They put their arms around you and love you when you're not so lovable.
author: Deb Caletti

text: There's nothing that makes you more insane than family. Or more happy, or more exasperated, or more secure.
author: Jim Butcher

text: In time of test, family is best.
author: Burmese Proverb

text: If the family were a boat, it would be a canoe that makes no progress unless everyone paddles.
author: Letty Cottin Pogrebin

text: One day you will do things for me that you hate. That is what it means to be family.
author: Jonathan Safran Foer

text: My dear young cousin, if there's one thing I've learned over the eons, it's that you can't give up on your family, no matter how tempting they make it.
author: Rick Riordan

text: Rejoice with your family in the beautiful land of life.
author: Albert Einstein

text: What can you do to promote world peace? Go home and love your family.
author: Mother Teresa

text: Family and friendships are two of the greatest facilitators of happiness.
author: John C. Maxwell

text: Parents were the only ones obligated to love you; from the rest of the world you had to earn it.
author: Ann Brashares

text: Nothing is better than going home to family and eating good food and relaxing.
author: Irina Shayk

text: Family and friends are hidden treasures, seek them and enjoy their riches.
author: Wanda Hope Carter

text: Friends are the family you choose.
author: Jess C. Scott

text: Other things may change us, but we start and end with the family.
author: Anthony Brandt

text: Stick to the basics, hold on to your family and friends – they will never go out of fashion.
author: Niki Taylor

text: The world, we'd discovered, doesn't love you like your family loves you.
author: Louis Zamperini

text: Home is people. Not a place. If you go back there after the people are gone, then all you can see is what is not there any more.
author: Robin Hobb

text: It is the smile of a child, the love of a mother, the joy of a father, the togetherness of a family.
author: Menacheim Begin

text: Home is where you are loved the most and act the worst.
author: Marjorie Pay Hinckley

text: Ohana means family and family means nobody gets left behind or forgotten.
author: Stitch

text: There is no doubt that it is around the family and the home that all the greatest virtues… are created, strengthened and maintained.
author: Winston Churchill

text: You need a rock-solid foundation of friends and family to keep you where you need to be.
author: Lilly Singh

text: Some people are worth melting for.
author: Olaf

text: I sustain myself with the love of family.
author: Maya Angelou

text: Nothing purchased can come close to the renewed sense of gratitude for having family and friends.
author: Courtland Milloy

text: Life is beautiful. It's about giving. It's about family.
author: Walt Disney

text: A family is a bunch of people who keep confusing you with someone you were as a kid.
author: Robert Brault

text: Home isn't where you're from, it's where you find light when all grows dark.
author: Pierce Brown

text: A dysfunctional family is any family with more than one person in it.
author: Mary Karr

text: Our most basic instinct is not for survival but for family.
author: Paul Pearsall

text: A man travels the world over in search of what he needs, and returns home to find it.
author: George A. Moore

text: I don't think quantity time is as special as quality time with your family.
author: Reba McEntire

text: You are born into your family and your family is born into you. No returns. No exchanges.
author: Elizabeth Berg

text: I have a wonderful shelter, which is my family.
author: José Carreras

text: In every conceivable manner, the family is a link to our past, bridge to our future.
author: Alex Haley

text: Your father’s greatest investment was not in property. It was you.
author: Unknown

text: Before sucess, there was a mother.
author: Unknown

text: Our parents are the bones on which we sharpen our teeth.
author: Joy Williams

text: To the world, you are a mother. To your family, you are the world.
author: Unknown

text: A father’s goodness is higher than the mountain; a mother’s goodness is deeper than the sea.
author: Japanese Proverb

text: A mother is not a person to lean on, but a person to make leaning on easier.
author: Barbara De Angelis

text: Success is never a solo act; it is a symphony played on the strings of a mother's prayers.
author: Unknown

text: Reminder: Say "I love you" to your mom today.
author: Unknown

text: Mother is the heartbeat in the home; and without her, there seems to be no heartthrob.
author: Leroy Brownlow

text: I'll love you forever. I'll like you for always. As long as I'm living, my mommy you'll be.
author: Robert Munsch

text: A mother is your first friend, your best friend, your forever friend.
author: Unknown

text: Mother love is the fuel that enables a normal human being to do the impossible.
author: Marion C. Garretty

text: A mother's arms are made of tenderness and children sleep soundly in them.
author: Victor Hugo

text: To the world you are a mother. To your family you are the world.
author: Unknown

text: A father is neither an anchor to hold us back nor a sail to take us there, but a guiding light whose love shows us the way.
author: Unknown

text: Any man can be a father, but it takes someone special to be a dad.
author: Anne Geddes

text: My father didn't tell me how to live. He lived, and let me watch him do it.
author: Clarence Budington Kelland

text: A daughter needs a dad to be the standard against which she will judge all men.
author: Gregory E. Lang

text: A father's love is forever imprinted on his child's heart.
author: Jennifer Williamson

text: Children are not a distraction from more important work. They are the most important work.
author: C.S. Lewis

text: A child can teach an adult three things: to be happy for no reason, to always be busy with something, and to know how to demand with all his might that which he desires.
author: Paulo Coelho

text: Making the decision to have a child is momentous. It is to decide forever to have your heart go walking around outside your body.
author: Elizabeth Stone

text: Before I had my child, I thought I knew all the boundaries of myself. Then I had this child, and I discovered depths I never knew existed.
author: Sheldon Kopp

text: A grandmother is a little bit parent, a little bit teacher, and a little bit best friend.
author: Unknown

text: Grandmothers hold our tiny hands for just a little while, but our hearts forever.
author: Unknown

text: Nobody can do for little children what grandparents do. Grandparents sort of sprinkle stardust over the lives of little children.
author: Alex Haley

text: A grandfather is someone with silver in his hair and gold in his heart.
author: Unknown

text: My grandfather taught me that wisdom isn't something you find — it's something you live.
author: Unknown

text: Grandparents are the footprints left for generations to follow.
author: Unknown

text: The reason grandchildren and grandparents get along so well is that they have a common enemy.
author: Sam Levenson

text: Grandparents make the world a little softer, a little kinder, a little warmer.
author: Unknown

text: A sibling is the one person who knows exactly where you came from and loves you anyway.
author: Unknown

text: Brothers and sisters are as close as hands and feet.
author: Vietnamese Proverb

text: A sister is both your mirror and your opposite.
author: Elizabeth Fishel

text: Having a sister means you always have backup. For life.
author: Unknown

text: The best thing about having a brother is that you always had a friend you didn't get to choose — and somehow it worked out perfectly.
author: Unknown

text: Siblings: the only people who will pick on you for their own entertainment and then defend you fiercely to everyone else.
author: Unknown

text: Growing up, I thought I was annoyed by my sibling. Now I realize I was just practicing how much I'd miss them.
author: Unknown

text: There is no better friend than a sibling. And there is no better sibling than you.
author: Unknown

text: God could not be everywhere, and therefore he made mothers.
author: Jewish Proverb

text: A place where someone still thinks of you is a place you can call home.
author: Jiraiya

text: To my dear daughter... I will always be watching over you, even from the stars. Happy 50th birthday.
author: Violet Evergarden

text: Ohana means family. Family means nobody gets left behind or forgotten.
author: Stitch
